URmessage identity preview (slice 0)

These are the screens, with made-up data; nothing is encrypted in this build.

WHAT THIS IS
A first look at the screens of identity phase 1, before any of them works:
  - Set up this device, with a code or "This is my first device"
  - the 25 words, then typing them back
  - Settings > Account: Your ID, and Devices
  - Add a device, with the seven emoji on both computers' screens
  - the five endings of adding a device
  - the Remove dialog, and the screen a removed device shows
  - a notice, and the alarm
  - Change my recovery phrase

Every account, device, ID, code, emoji, date and word in it is made up, and each screen says
so. The 25 words are a fixed demo list, labelled "Demo words: not a recovery phrase": they are
not a recovery phrase of any account.

This build has no live mode. It never connects to anything and never reads a credential, and
the library that encrypts (URnetworkSdk.dll) is not in this zip.

HOW TO RUN IT
1. Unzip this folder anywhere.
2. Run URmessage.exe. It opens on "Set up this device".
3. Click through. "This is my first device" shows the 25 words, then asks for them back
   ("Demo only: fill in the demo words" types them for you). Settings > Account has Your ID,
   Devices, Add a device and Change my recovery phrase; under "DEMO ONLY: MORE SCREENS" it
   opens every other screen.

The screens that show or take the words are excluded from screen capture, so a screenshot of
them comes out black. That is on purpose.

It keeps its own settings and log in %LOCALAPPDATA%\URmessage-identity-preview, apart from
the URmessage you test with, and it runs beside it. To remove it, delete this folder and that
one, and, if you like, the registry key HKCU\Software\URmessage-identity-preview, which
holds its window position.
